summary: Excavate aging documents for staleness, dead links, process drift, phantom dependencies, and obsolete examples.

facts.text: Excavate aging documents for staleness, dead links, process drift, phantom dependencies, and obsolete examples.
Stale Facts - claims about state-of-the-world that have changed
Dead Links - URLs that 404, redirect to unrelated destinations
Drift from Current Process - procedures that no longer reflect actual practice
Phantom Dependencies - scripts, files, tools, people that no longer exist
Obsolete Examples - code snippets reflecting prior API or UI
Last-Updated Lens - estimate age, catalog time-sensitive claims, set decay risk (low/medium/high)
Fact-Check Pass - verify each claim against current state
Link-Check Pass - verify every URL; flag auth-gated as "unverified"
Process-Check Pass - verify procedures against current practice at step level
Dependency-Check Pass - check scripts, files, tools, channels, people
Severity: Critical/Misleading → High/Outdated → Medium/Cosmetic → Low/Historical
Update in place - targeted fixes; structure is sound
Restructure and refresh - major rewrites needed
Deprecate with pointer - superseded, add deprecation banner
Archive - historical state; remove from search
Delete - fully phantom, all claims stale
Noting a doc is old without running any passes (ostrich mode)
Rewriting when targeted refresh would suffice
Deleting load-bearing historical context
Treating unverifiable as confirmed
Auditing an old runbook or onboarding doc before a team relies on it during an incident, to catch dead links, phantom dependencies, and obsolete examples before they cause real damage.
